note: Rust-backed S02 cases: a case passes only when every listed cargo test reports ok in a judged log. `rows` links a case to the ledger rows it is evidence for (host decode evidence only; never a board, provider or performance claim). Python-only META cases are defined in run_cases.py.

cases.description: Ogg Vorbis 44.1 kHz stereo through Symphonia: peak/rms error against the independent ffmpeg decode, gapless length from the last Ogg granule, native rate, contiguous positions from 0.
Ogg Vorbis 48 kHz: the decoder reports the stream's own rate (not negotiated by the pinned Spotify client).
MP3 44.1 kHz through Symphonia (the `mp3` feature E06 did not audit): error against ffmpeg and Apple decodes, gapless length from the file's own LAME/Info tag.
MP3 48 kHz: native rate reported, gapless length from the tag.
ALAC 44.1/16 from raw packets plus the 24-byte cookie: bit exact against the integer source signal.
ALAC 48/24 from raw packets plus the cookie: all 24 bits exact against the integer source signal.
AAC-LC 44.1 kHz stereo from raw frames plus the AudioSpecificConfig: error against ffmpeg and Apple decodes, packets x 1024 frames.
AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo, same checks.
PCM S16BE: bit exact against the source; a byte count ending inside a frame and unsupported channel counts are refused.
Every decoder reports its native rate; 44.1 kHz selects the bridge and 48 kHz the direct path in the rate stage; the 48 kHz frame count is exact.
Seek (accurate, decoder reset, preroll, discard) to six targets: the output equals continuous decoding from the target, bit for bit.
The same for MP3, whose bit reservoir and filterbank state need the preroll.
A position past the end saturates to the duration and yields no audio (librespot saturates the same way).
ALAC (preroll 0) and AAC-LC (preroll 1 packet) restart after a reset and then equal continuous decoding.
A chained Ogg stream 44.1 then 48 kHz: one explicit format change at the exact first-stream length, nothing lost from either part.
A concatenated MP3 stream 44.1 then 48 kHz: one explicit format change, no frames swallowed by the first stream's tag-derived trimming.
A leading ID3v2 tag is skipped and the audio decodes identically.
A container of another codec is refused by name, not decoded as the negotiated one.
Truncation at fifteen points: refused, ended or failed, and every sample decoded is a prefix of the full decode.
96 single-bit corruptions per format: no panic, caps respected, and the damage is visible somewhere.
Empty, zero, noise, header-only and MP3-looking garbage: refused or ended, no panic, no runaway output.
Allocation caps: input bytes, block frames, channels and packet bytes are refused before use.
The ALAC cookie is validated (length, version, depth 16/24, channels, frameLength cap, rate) before a decoder exists.

AAC accepts only LC with 1024-sample frames and 1-2 channels; 5.1/7.1 is refused before decoding as BLOCKED airplay.aac_lc_multichannel (never downmixed); HE-AAC, LD, ELD, PCE, 960 frames and bad indexes are named.
Half, bit-flipped and noise packets through ALAC and AAC: errors are values, never panics.

The bridge vector file holds no case the Rust test list does not test.
The output stream is identical for twelve input chunkings, counters included.
After n input frames the bridge has produced exactly ceil(160 n / 147) frames, for n = 0..400, mono and stereo.
A constant input comes out exactly constant once the history is full (every phase sums to exactly 1).
An impulse peaks at the output frame the stated 32-input-frame delay predicts.
Overshoot is clamped to the Q23 range and counted, never wrapped.
Only 44 100 (bridged) and 48 000 (direct) are admitted; every other rate, including 88 200 and 96 000, is an explicit refusal.
Zero and more than two channels are refused by the bridge and by the adapter.
Ragged input and a too-small output buffer are errors that consume nothing.
Reset gives zero history and zero counters.
At 48 kHz the adapter is the f32 to Q23 conversion and nothing else.
At 44.1 kHz the f32 adapter equals the integer bridge, whole or split.
f32/Q23/s16 conversions are exact where exactness is possible and clamp elsewhere; NaN is 0.

All 107 hand-written offers (15 admitted, 92 refused) get exactly the verdict and refusal code in tests/s02/admission.json: every mandatory ledger row admitted at its ledger rate, channels and width; every not-requested name, the blocked multichannel names, ELD/LD/HE, Opus, 88.2/96 kHz, wrong channel counts, missing or oversize config refused.
Every one of the 14 refusal codes is produced by some case, and the file names exactly the codes the code has.
The name and config limits stated in the file are the constants in the code.
A 32-byte format name is a name; one byte more is a length refusal.
A refusal's text and echo stay bounded and never contain config bytes, whatever the offer holds.
A name is never admitted as a codec of another family; nothing falls through to a default codec.
Twenty twins of the admitted AAC-LC offer differ only in the config (ELD, HE-AAC, PS, LD, Main, 960 frames, PCE, flags, bad indexes) and are all refused, not downgraded to LC.
Removing Vorbis from the input changes no other verdict (the requirement set is not coupled).
Calling-thread requested-byte observations for the nine existing stereo fixtures, first-use and warm; not RSS or board admission.
